response: The Taoiseach is out claiming in Limerick that housing tenancies have risen even after his government's March 1 rules forced landlords into six-year leases, while trying to brush off the spike in eviction notices and homelessness. Yet the numbers of people in emergency accommodation have climbed again nationally. This is the predictable result of heavy-handed government interference in private rental agreements, undermining property rights and family stability instead of letting personal responsibility and market signals maintain order.
